newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France to hold same-day repo tender May 2.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France to hold same-day repo tender May 2.

text.p: The Bank of France said on Monday it will hold a same-day money market tender on Friday because of a French public holiday on May 1, and will announce the rate for the tender, the intervention rate, on Friday morning.
A Bank of France spokesman confirmed next week's regular monetary policy council meeting would be on Wednesday, May 7, as Thursday, May 8, will also be a public holiday.
French futures and options exchange MATIF SA said in a statement on Monday trading on GLOBEX would be open from 0800 GMT to 1600 GMT on both the May 1 and May 8 public holidays.
It said there would be trading in futures and options on the French franc bond, Ecu bond and PIBOR interest rate contracts. It also said the CAC-40 futures contract would be traded.
